title: Alone Together with the Dungeon Dive and Perplexing Ruins - Episode 1 (Solo RPG Friday)
body:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=F5y8-ztKpCM

Daniel (@dungeondive) launches a recurring conversation series with Allan of Perplexing Ruins, designer of *Fallen*, aimed at helping viewers navigate the indie tabletop RPG scene. This first episode establishes the shape: two people trading discoveries, with an honest accounting of how they found them.

Allan's route in is the more unusual one. A bookseller for a decade with an arts background, he had never role-played before the pandemic, bounced hard off D&D's aesthetic and heft, then found *d100 Dungeon* and described it as playing NES Final Fantasy by yourself. Posting art on Reddit led to commissions, which led to designing. Both men circle the term OSR and largely abandon it — nobody agrees what it means anymore, and Mörk Borg gets filed under it despite being thoroughly modern.

The practical advice is the episode's spine: *Basic Fantasy* or *White Box* will outfit a table for years for fifteen dollars; itch.io lets you build a game shelf for twenty; print at home and hand-stitch if you must. Allan's picks are *Five Leagues from the Borderlands* and *MÖRK BORG*-adjacent zine *Miro*; Daniel's are *Downtime in Zeon*, *Regicide*, and the solo-native *Mystic Punks*.

----

How do you keep up with the indie RPG scene — social feeds, storefronts, or word of mouth?
